description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מפרטת הצהרות המבוטח בנוגע לרכב שלו וזכאותו לשירותים, כחלק מפוליסת ביטוח רכב פרטי ומסחרי. ההצהרות מתייחסות למצב הרכב, גיל הנהג ותקופת רישיון הנהיגה שלו, וכן לפניה לקבלת שירותים מגורמים אחרים. המטרה היא להבהיר את תנאי השימוש בשירותי חלופה. ההצהרות כוללות מצב הרכב, גיל הנהג (פחות מ־24 שנים), ותק הרישיון (פחות משנתיים), וכן את ההשלכות של פנייה לספק שירותים אחר ללא אישור מראש. פוליסת ביטוח רכב פרטי ומסחרי.

G. Declarations by the insured
The insured hereby declares and undertakes as follows:
That the insured vehicle is in his possession, is suitable for traveling and has not been involved in an accident whose damages have not yet been repaired.
That if an alternative vehicle is not provided as a result of the insured being younger than 24 years, and/or due to him not possessing a va lid driver's license for more than 2 years, the service provider shall act as noted in paragraph C12 above.
That it is aware that an approach to another entity in order to obtain the service, without obtaining the service provider's advance authorization, shall not entitle him to a refund of the expenses or part thereof, or any other payment, even if it was entitled to receive the service from the service provider had it approached the service provider.

This table outlines declarations made by the insured regarding their vehicle and eligibility for services. It details conditions related to vehicle condition, driver age/license validity, and obtaining services from other providers.
ממדים: insured declarations, declaration details

G. Declarations by the insured
The insured hereby declares and undertakes as follows:
That the insured vehicle is in his possession, is suitable for traveling and has not been involved in an accident whose damages have not yet been repaired.
That if an alternative vehicle is not provided as a result of the insured being younger than 24 years, and/or due to him not possessing a va lid driver's license for more than 2 years, the service provider shall act as noted in paragraph C12 above.
That it is aware that an approach to another entity in order to obtain the service, without obtaining the service provider's advance authorization, shall not entitle him to a refund of the expenses or part thereof, or any other payment, even if it was entitled to receive the service from the service provider had it approached the service provider.
